before.label: today: manual
before.total: ≈ 47 min of staff time per request

steps.task: Check eligibility and whether the payer needs auth for this CPT code
Pull clinical notes, imaging reports and therapy history from the EHR
Read the notes against the payer's medical-necessity policy
Key the request into the payer portal, or fill and fax the form
Chase status by portal checks and phone calls
Answer requests for more information and set up peer-to-peers
Draft and send appeals on denials (averaged over all requests)
Record the auth number in the EHR and release the scheduling hold

after.label: agent workflow
after.total: ≈ 9 min of human review per request

steps.task: Pick up the order from the EHR, run eligibility, look up the payer's auth list
Decide auth needed, not needed or unclear; send unclear cases to a coordinator
Pull notes, imaging and therapy history for a minimum-necessary window
Map evidence to each payer criterion with note citations; flag gaps
Review the evidence summary and sign the clinical attestation
Fill the payer's clinical form fields and assemble the attachments
Submit by portal, fax or X12 278 and log the reference number
Read payer letters and portal status; route approvals, pends and denials
On a denial, draft the appeal against the stated reason for clinician signature
